Cluster for non-independent effects sharing the same source/response/taxon/outcome/treatment.
Metric passed to metafor or modeled directly; examples include raw_rate, log_odds_ratio_mortality, and log_response_ratio.
Direction of positive yi, because higher values mean different things for healing rate versus mortality.

Single perforate/imperforate moderator only when the covariate layer marks it unambiguous.
Coarse normalized growth-form moderator from the covariate layer.
